criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use an elevated isometric projection with matching diagonal ground axes.
Both frame industrial territory left and residential territory right.
different: The CANDIDATE is slightly more top-down and wider, making world objects appear smaller.
The REFERENCE concentrates the focal network nearer the center.

evidence.observation: Elevated isometric world view with diagonal roads and broad left-to-right utility framing.
Closely matched isometric axes, with a somewhat higher and wider world framing.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both maps contain industrial clusters, residential masses, roads, and utility corridors.
Occupied zones extend across most of each frame.
different: The REFERENCE has denser continuous micro-detail and more organic mass distribution.
The CANDIDATE leaves broader tiled corridors and uses more repetitive residential blocks.

evidence.observation: Dense rubble, roads, facilities, and housing create near-continuous map texture.
Large building clusters are present, but open grid plots and repeated blocks remain conspicuous.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both show a narrow winding dark-blue channel through industrial terrain.
Both use recessed rocky banks and subdued water reflections.
different: The channel curvature and screen placement differ materially.
The CANDIDATE makes bridge decks and bank edges much more prominent than the REFERENCE.

evidence.observation: Organic narrow channel winds through rubble with comparatively quiet crossings.
Central winding channel has sharply defined banks and conspicuous raised bridge geometry.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Plants, pylons, substations, and housing share broadly comparable role-based sizing.
Utility towers remain readable above surrounding buildings in both.
different: CANDIDATE housing is smaller and more repetitive relative to pylons.
CANDIDATE bridge and industrial silhouettes occupy different proportions from the REFERENCE landmarks.

evidence.observation: Large plant, towers, and ancillary structures form a cohesive relative scale.
Residential substation is prominent but remains proportionate to nearby homes.
Industrial plant and pylons dominate more strongly over nearby small buildings.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use blackened metal, soot-dark soil, worn concrete, and restrained amber windows.
Muted blue water and cyan electrical accents sit within the same low-midtoned palette.
different: The CANDIDATE ground reads more uniformly tiled and crushed-black.
The REFERENCE has richer localized metal and rubble highlights.

evidence.observation: Cohesive layered metal, concrete, rubble, soil, and amber illumination.
Very similar dark industrial material family with flatter tiled ground passages.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both distinguish energized cyan conductors from planned amber dashed routes.
Both routes follow sequences of color-matched pylons and remain readable across the map.
different: The CANDIDATE conductors are thinner and less luminous.
Several CANDIDATE route turns appear looser at tower attachments.

evidence.observation: Bright multi-strand cyan conductors visibly connect the upper and right substations.
Amber dotted construction route tracks clearly through amber pylons.
Cyan multi-line route and pale towers clearly indicate energized infrastructure.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use riveted black industrial chrome across top status, left kit, and right inspector panels.
Overlay proportions and cyan/amber hierarchy integrate similarly with the map.
different: The CANDIDATE inspector has more unused dark space and smaller secondary text.
The CANDIDATE top status bar is more segmented and visually busier.

evidence.observation: Compact riveted top bar presents resources, power, date, and pause state.
Right inspector uses a compact image, capacity, meter, and action hierarchy.
Closely matched riveted top chrome with cyan and amber status bands.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both use a centered four-cell bottom strip with heavy industrial chrome and one cyan-highlighted stage.
The CANDIDATE visibly provides construction progress, current stage, result, and next-stage cells.
different: The CANDIDATE uses slightly narrower text-led cells while the REFERENCE uses larger icon-led controls.

evidence.observation: Centered four-control playback strip with clear active cyan selection.
Independent four-stage event bar shows numeric progress, active stage, result, and next.
